note: KOA Holiday off I-75 near Renfro Valley, Mt. Vernon, its pull-through and back-in sites in terraced rows on a wooded hillside. Pool mid-May to mid-September, mini golf, camper kitchen, snack bar and propane; patio and fenced paw-pen sites, cabins and a lodge. Cashless. Several 50-amp and big-rig site types take only rigs of 28 ft or more. --Claude
summary: Kept on the October capture (cheapest $50.00 back-in W/E for a 23-ft motorhome, high $85; reserve page now behind Cloudflare Turnstile, so not re-quoted). Year-round, 50A full hookups and W/E, pull-throughs to 75 ft. Google 4.2 / 568. No gateway within 40 km. Ambiguous '$5 per person / per day / per vehicle' parking-permit line could push the night over $50 - flagged.

ALL guests must register at the office to obtain a parking permit at $5 per person, $5 per day, & $5 per vehicle **'. Read with the first sentence it most likely charges visitors/extra guests beyond the base 2 people and 1 vehicle; if it applies to every registered camper it is a mandatory per-person fee and the cheapest night is $55+ (drop candidate under the mandatory-fees rule). Worth a question to AWH or a call.
